subject: School Capital Plan Priorities
overview: The subcommittee reviewed the district's capital projects list and gathered updates on building maintenance, security needs, and facility assessments ahead of the municipal budget cycle. Members began categorizing and prioritizing items, voting to continue the discussion to November 19, 2024.

items.title: Review and Update of School Capital Plan
items.summary: The committee reviewed existing and proposed capital items—including HVAC and roof replacements, network closet cooling, plaza ADA remediation, security upgrades, and building assessments—and began organizing them by urgency and funding eligibility ahead of the municipal budget season.
